anchors.description: Front-to-back depth of the slatted wooden table with white steel frame, between the far and near long edges of its top surface.
anchors.visible_evidence: Both long edges of the planar slatted tabletop are visible in the crop; the two points lie on the far and near edge lines of that top surface.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Beer-garden/patio tables (Biertisch type) are nominally 80 cm deep; a non-standard table could differ by a few cm.

anchors.description: Height of the table top above the ground, from the front-left corner of the top to the foot of the adjacent white steel leg.
anchors.visible_evidence: The front-left top corner and the ground contact of the front-left steel leg are both clearly visible on the asphalt.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Dining/patio table heights are 73-78 cm; the leg foot is inset ~5-10 cm from the top corner, adding a small horizontal component.

anchors.description: Seat height of the long wooden bench with steel frame legs, from the seat top surface down to the ground beneath it.
anchors.visible_evidence: The bench faces the camera so its seat top surface is visible, and the concrete ground beside the steel base plate is visible directly below it.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Beer-garden bench seat heights are 44-47 cm; the ground point lies slightly nearer to the camera than the seat point, adding a small extra 3D component.
